takeaway: Correction: the 0.84 forecast score reported yesterday came from a ten-times-bigger pool padded with easy-to-rank apps. A new like-for-like score, over each forecast's own top 100, puts the Nov 1–3 forecasts at 0.26–0.41, below October's 0.53–0.70. Skill collections led today's measured gains.

findings.heading: Correction: forecasts did not improve
findings.text: On a fixed top-100 pool, the Nov 1–3 forecasts score 0.26, 0.32 and 0.41, against 0.53–0.70 for October's (pools of 72–103 apps). Yesterday's 0.84 reflected pool size, not skill. The new column is on the scorecard below.

findings.heading: meta/astryx leads measured gains again
findings.text: Meta's agent-ready design system gained 3,185 stars in a day, to 20,839, faster than the day before (+2,884).

findings.heading: Skill collections accelerate; Jane Street publishes one
findings.text: anthropics/skills gained 1,465 (up from 987), mattpocock/skills 1,173 and cloudflare/security-audit-skill 1,181. janestreet/agent_skills, a single Socratic-tutor skill created Nov 3, went from 705 to 2,532 stars.

findings.heading: monday.com: $36M ARR from AI products
findings.text: monday.com's Q3 release says its AI products (AI credits, agents and vibe) reached $36 million in AI ARR. Read from search results.

findings.heading: Hugging Face is back
findings.text: After 22 failed days, the radar read 200 trending Hugging Face Spaces and models. These are baseline readings; their measured growth starts tomorrow.

caveats: Compare forecasts on the new top-100 column, not the full rank correlation, which rises with pool size alone.
The self-tuner still judges settings on the full rank correlation; whether to switch is a decision for a person.
Hacker News and npm remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
